title: Paying Someone to Make HeyGen Avatar Ads: Options and Terms
summary: You can pay an agency for finished HeyGen-style presenter ads or hire an operator to run HeyGen for you. Compare plans, credits, consent and testimonial rules.
body_markdown:
## Hiring someone to run your HeyGen account


Hiring an operator means paying for their hours plus your credits. Before the first render, get four things in writing.


- **Account ownership.** The HeyGen account, the avatar and the voice should sit in your name, or transfer to you on request.
- **Consent for every likeness.** An avatar of you is one thing. An avatar or voice of anyone else needs that person's written permission.
- **A credit estimate.** At 31 credits a minute for Avatar IV, a 30-second script costs about 15.5 credits per take before retakes, by our arithmetic. Ask for a monthly budget, not a per-video promise.
- **Export settings.** Creator exports at 1080p and Pro at 4K, so choose the plan that matches the placement you buy.


## Real people versus avatars for testimonials


The[FTC's rule on fake reviews and testimonials](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/08/federal-trade-commission-announces-final-rule-banning-fake-reviews-testimonials) , effective October 21, 2024, bans testimonials that misrepresent who gave them. The FTC's questions and answers say the rule has no blanket ban on AI avatars, but an avatar testimonial is prohibited if the underlying testimonial is fake or false. Use an AI presenter for a brand statement you can back up, and a real customer for any experience claim.


If you need a real person on camera, the route changes. As of October 2026, Brighter Click sells 12 edited videos from 4 creators for $4,500 with full usage rights in perpetuity, and its[UGC agency page](https://www.brighterclick.com/ugc-agency) gives 10 to 14 business days for that 12-video package. That is about $375 per edited video by our arithmetic.


## When to keep HeyGen in-house


Keep HeyGen in-house when your team will direct its own videos and one presenter carries the campaign. The translation feature suits one ad that must run in several languages, since lip-matched translation covers more than 175 languages and dialects. Measure one full batch first, including script fixes and review time, before you pay an operator to do the same work.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify, our top pick, makes finished AI presenter ads with a person checking each one, so you do not need to run HeyGen yourself.
- HeyGen's Creator plan is $29 a month with 600 credits, and A-roll changes re-render and use credits.
- Put account ownership, likeness consent and a credit estimate in writing before any operator starts.
- Under the FTC's rule, an AI avatar cannot deliver a fake or false testimonial, so use real customers for those claims.
- Compare routes on cost per approved ad, including the operator's hours.


## FAQ


### Is hiring someone to run HeyGen cheaper than an agency?


It can be for a small test, because the Creator plan costs $29 a month. Per finished ad, the answer depends on script fixes, since each A-roll change re-renders and uses credits. Compare the operator's total cost with a managed quote for the same number of approved ads.


### Who should own the avatar and the exported files?


You should. Put the account, avatar, voice and exports in your name, or require a transfer on request, and agree it before the operator starts. If the operator leaves, you should still be able to keep producing ads.


### Can an AI avatar give a customer testimonial?


Not a made-up one. The FTC's rule bans testimonials that misrepresent who gave them, and its questions and answers say an avatar delivering a fake or false testimonial is prohibited. Keep avatars to brand statements, and use real customers for experience claims.


### Does HeyGen run ads for me?


Not as far as its homepage shows, since the page does not mention ads specifically. Treat HeyGen as a video tool, and look for campaign management as a separate service with its own terms.


### What is the best option after HeyGen?


Knowlify, our top pick, if you want finished, human-checked presenter ads with no tool to run. Creatify Studio and Airpost offer managed routes with published terms. If a real customer must appear on camera, compare Brighter Click on the same brief, since Knowlify does not supply real creators.
